title: Create a customer-defined control
summary: A draft guide for documenting a control defined by an organisation rather than supplied as part of a confirmed framework.

blocks.text: A customer-defined control can document an organisation-specific measure that is important to its compliance programme. This sample does not prescribe the fields or workflow used by DRisk.

items: Confirm that the organisation needs a control that is not already represented by an available control.
Define the outcome the control is intended to achieve.
Document the responsible owner, frequency, and evidence expectations according to your internal process.
Create the control using the approved DRisk workflow.
Review the saved control with the relevant compliance owner.
